verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents connecting GitHub so it can read your code and so agents can open pull requests. Agent access then takes a few steps: a global npm install, `foreloop init` to drop the task-executor skill into a checkout, and an API key or MCP URL ('that URL and an API key and nothing else'). That is lightweight but not a one-click install, and the agent runs locally in your own checkout rather than being granted repo access through a single install. Missing for 10: an explicit one-click GitHub App or repository-grant flow, documented detail on the GitHub connection steps, and independent or hands-on confirmation that setup is simple.
